Names in the records
Barnabas Lambson
Born
about 1597 · Ridgewell, Essex, England
Died
before February 1640 · Cambridge, Massachusetts

Left England for Massachusetts Bay in 1635 and settled in Cambridge, where he held land and served in town government. His reported passage on the Defence still needs passenger-list confirmation.

FamilySearch gives a birth about 1597 in Ridgewell, Essex, England, and death before February 1640 in Cambridge, Massachusetts. Barnabas migrated in 1635. His marriage to Marie is reported as about 1627 in Ridgewell. The exact passenger-list identification remains unconfirmed.
